name: Unbreathing Horde
oracle_text:
This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each other Zombie you control and each Zombie card in your graveyard.
If this creature would be dealt damage, prevent that damage and remove a +1/+1 counter from it.
blocked_sentences: If this creature would be dealt damage, prevent that damage and remove a +1/+1 counter from it.

needs.what: a continuous total-shield replacement on a permanent (static prevent_damage with prevent_all, affects self_only) whose one replacement event both prevents all of a damage event and removes exactly one +1/+1 counter from the shielded permanent, regardless of the damage amount (Protean Hydra's sibling with a fixed one instead of 'that many')
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The prevent_damage static's 'counter' rider (Panther Habit, characteristics.damage_into_counters) only PUTS 'that many' counters and the loader refuses any counter but +1/+1; there is no remove direction or fixed amount. prevent_damage_permanent's 'effects' rider is a one-shot op limited to duration this_turn, not a continuous static. A separate damage_prevented trigger with remove_counters would use the stack instead of being part of the replacement, so it is an approximation
